notes: Per-spec leveling reservations (sim-accuracy round 10). Below 60 a band's talent build is the guide's level-60 build cut down by the top-row-down walk (sim/leveling LadderTalentString). A spec listed here takes these ranks of its own tree first, in order, each once the build can legally hold it and never past the guide's own rank for that talent, then walks as before; so the ladder only ever adds points and its level-60 build is the guide's. A row is adopted only where the band builds it makes beat the plain walk's beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001 (10,000 iterations, the band's own heal profile, both factions), keep every talent the engine models only by a probe as zero, drop nothing the rotation casts and lose at no band. The evidence is in design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round10/healprofile.md and design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round11/healprofile.md. sim/leveling embeds a copy (make ladder-first-sync); TestEmbeddedLadderFirstMatchesCurated holds it to this file. An order-only row (owner, 2026-11-04) moves no published band: where the bands tie, real leveling play decides the order, and its reason says why in one line.

druid-balance.reason: After Moonkin Form, Heart of the Wild 42 to 46, Naturalist (2% damage a point) 47 to 51 and Reflection 52 to 54 before Nature's Focus, which only saves casts from pushback on a target that never hits you; Subtlety (threat) last. Gains at every level 42 to 58 (sim-accuracy round 29, walks-dps lane; bare band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, design/reviews/2026-11-07-sim-audit-round29/walksdps.md).

druid-feral.reason: The plain walk spends Savage Fury at 23 and 24 while Sharpened Claws (3% crit a point in Cat Form) waits for 26, and Predatory Discipline, which only changes Ferocious Bite (the cat Bites little before raid gear, and the ladder's bare fight never does), at 31 ahead of Leader of the Pack, Blood Frenzy, Natural Instinct and Rend and Tear. This order takes Shredding Attacks at 20 to 22 (its first point does nothing alone, but taking Sharpened Claws first at 20 costs 1.9 to 3.0% at 21 and 22, where the second point makes Shred the builder), Sharpened Claws at 23 and 24, Feral Charge at 25 (in Forever it is also a Cat Form leap behind the target, the only way a solo cat Shreds a mob that faces it), Savage Fury, Predatory Strikes, then Leader of the Pack, Blood Frenzy, Natural Instinct and Rend and Tear, with Predatory Discipline at 39 to open Shifting Power. Bare band 20 and 30 gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: 23 +1.4%, 24 +2.7%, 26 +1.3%, 31 to 33 +3.0 to 3.4%, 34 and 35 +0.7 to 0.9%, 36 to 38 +0.5%; levels 20, 25, 27 to 30 and 40 do not change (sim-accuracy round 28, hybrids lane).

druid-feral-bear.reason: Tank rule (coordinator, round 29): a threat talent goes ahead of a survival talent only where the tank fight's chance of death rises by less than 5 points at every level the swap touches. The 10-point row is paid with Thick Hide 3 and Feral Swiftness 1 instead of Feral Swiftness 2 and Feral Instinct 2 (Swipe is a two-target line): threat ties at 16 to 20 and chance of death falls. Savage Fury, Sharpened Claws, Shredding Attacks, Lacerate at 25, Blood Frenzy, Leader of the Pack at 30, Predatory Strikes, Natural Instinct and Rend and Tear from 36 (round 13's reservations kept), Feral Swiftness's second point at 39 so the band 40 boss's chance of death stays where it was, Primal Bite at 40, then Natural Reaction, Heart of the Wild and Naturalist; Feral Instinct last. Naturalist before Natural Reaction or Heart of the Wild raised chance of death 6 to 14 points at 50 to 55 and is not taken. Threat gains at 22 to 49 and 53 to 59; 16 to 21 and 50 to 52 tie on threat with a lower chance of death; no level's chance of death rises more than a point (sim-accuracy round 29, walks-dps lane; bare band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions, design/reviews/2026-11-07-sim-audit-round29/walksdps.md).

druid-restoration.reason: On each band's own fight, Restoration levels better with Heart of the Wild, all three ranks of Reflection and Bloom ahead of the top rows' other points, and Nature's Swiftness held as soon as it can be: beyond error at band 20 (round 11's pull profile, both factions) and band 30 (round 10), and no band loses. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): the list is now the whole order. Nature's Focus 3 to 5, Naturalist and Tranquil Spirit took 21 to 39 while Gift of Nature, Improved Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, Living Spirit and Genesis waited, and Nature's Swiftness's reservation pulled all five Naturalist points ahead of them; Nature's Splendor came last at 60. Now Bloom 20, Nature's Focus 21, Genesis 22, Gift of Nature 23 to 25, Improved Rejuvenation and Swiftmend by 29, Living Spirit 31 to 33, Genesis to 38, Nature's Majesty, Moonglow and Nature's Splendor by 44 (a Balance talent behind its own rows), then Improved Regrowth, Improved Tranquility, Tranquil Spirit and Naturalist, and Nature's Swiftness last at 60. Effective healing on each band's own fight, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level at 21, +0.0 to +1.6% at 22 to 29, +6.6 to +9.3% at 30 to 39, +7.5 to +14.4% at 40 to 49, +5.4 to +8.3% at 50 to 59.

hunter-beast-mastery.reason: Focused Fire at 15 and 16 (round 15, order only), then Unleashed Fury 20 to 24 and Ferocity 25 to 29 before Endurance Training's fourth point and Bestial Swiftness (pet health and run speed); Bestial Discipline 30 and 31, Bestial Swiftness and Intimidation 32 and 33 for Bestial Wrath, Frenzy 35 to 39. hunter-marksmanship.reason: Careful Aim (Intellect as attack power) before Efficiency at 15 to 19, and after Ranged Weapon Specialization, Deadly Aspects then Focused Fire (2% all damage) at 46 and 47 before the Endurance Training points that only open Unleashed Fury. Taking Strider Kick as soon as it fits gains about 10% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane); the other bands do not change. paladin-holy.reason: On band 30's own fight, Oath of Light ahead of Infusion of Light's second rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions (sim-accuracy round 11). The plain walk also spends Holy points a healer cannot use while live ones wait: at band 20 the 11th point goes to Purifying Power (Cleanse cost and the Exorcism and Holy Wrath cooldowns, none of which the healer casts) instead of Illumination, and at band 30 the 19th goes to Divine Precision (Holy spell hit; heals cannot miss) instead of Infusion of Light's second rank. Illumination's first rank, Divine Favor (which the rotation casts), Illumination to four ranks, Oath of Light, Illumination's fifth rank and both ranks of Infusion of Light, in that order, raise band 20's effective healing about 3.5% on its own fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001, hold band 30 level, and leave bands 35 to 60 on the plain walk (sim-accuracy round 15, paladin). The order keeps every level's build a superset of the level before (the walk takes the longest legal prefix) and still takes Oath of Light at 25. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Reverence at 15 and 16 before Healing Light, Illumination 20 to 24 before Divine Favor (now 30), Divine Intellect 26 to 29 and 31 before the dead tolls, Benediction and Conviction (6% crit) 32 to 39, then Purifying Power, Divine Precision and Infusion of Light only as Holy Shock's toll, Holy Shock at 45 (in a leveling dungeon it costs more mana than it returns until Holy Power is behind it), Boundless Light, Holy Power by 52, Light's Vigil 53, and Precision, Guardian's Favor and Sacred Duty, which do nothing for a healer, last. +1.3 to +10.8% at 15 to 18, +1.5 to +2.7% at 21 to 25, +0.2 to +4.6% at 26 to 40, +8.7 to +15.7% at 43 to 58, +4.3% at 59, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; at 41 and 42 a Human ties or trails by 0.5% until the tank's Flash of Light row follows the new talents (rank-choices.json, round 29).

paladin-protection.reason: Holy Shield, which the rotation casts from rank 1 at 30, sits on the 21-point row; a level 30 paladin's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the 21st on Improved Righteous Fury. Taking Holy Shield as soon as it fits (and Shieldsworn as soon as it fits, the capstone the spine already gave band 40) raises band 30's threat beyond error on the tank fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001 (sim-accuracy round 12, hybrids); damage taken rises about 2% with the Improved Righteous Fury point gone. No other band changes. Templar's Bulwark (the 10-point row, no level gate since the 70707 hotfix) is reserved ahead of them by owner ruling (first, because the walk takes the longest legal prefix of the list and Holy Shield cannot fit below 30) (sim-accuracy round 14): at band 20 it takes the second Sacred Duty point, which shortens only Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Bulwark itself. On the tank fight chance of death falls from about 77% to 66% for about 2% less threat; survival wins for a tank at this band, a stated exception to the threat metric that is not generalised to other bands or specs. Bands 25 and up already hold Bulwark and do not change. Shield Specialization (a block returns 4% mana) is held at 21 and 22 ahead of Sacred Duty's second point, and Swift Judgement (a second Judgement, from the 15-point row) at 25, the first level the row opens, ahead of Toughness's last four points, which only add armor. Tank fight, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: threat at 21 and 22 +2.3 to 3.2% with chance of death no higher, 25 to 28 +5.2 to 6.2%; levels 20, 23, 24 and 30 do not change (sim-accuracy round 28, hybrids lane).

paladin-retribution.reason: Vindication only lowers the target's attack power, so one point pays the row with Seal of Command: Vindication 1 at 23, Seal of Command 24, Sacred Arbiter 25, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 26 to 28, Vindication 2 at 29, Vengeance 30 to 32, Vindication 3 at 33 and Repentance 34 as Champion of the Light's tolls. Gains at every level 25 to 33; 24 ties (sim-accuracy round 29, walks-dps lane; bare band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, design/reviews/2026-11-07-sim-audit-round29/walksdps.md).

priest-discipline.reason: On band 20's own fight, Meditation ahead of Mental Agility's first rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; on band 30's, Penance (which the rotation casts) ahead of Soul Warding does too; no other band changes. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Meditation 20 to 22 (it was 20, 28 and 29), Inner Focus, Mental Agility and Improved Power Word: Shield to Penance at 30, then Improved Renew 31 to 33 and Soul Warding, Twilight Focus 35 to 37 and Holy Specialization 38 to 42 before Renewed Hope and Divine Aegis (43 to 49), Divine Fury, Improved Healing 54 to 56 and Inspiration last. +6 to +15% at 21 to 28, +0.2 to +4.9% at 31 to 48, +1.9 to +6.1% at 54 to 59 (3,000-iteration sweep, Horde seed 1; the 10,000-iteration cells are in the round's report).

priest-holy.reason: Prayer of Mending, which the rotation casts, is the Holy tree's deepest talent; the plain walk leaves it out at band 40. Taking it there, with Spiritual Healing's three ranks taken as soon as they can be held (ahead of Spiritual Guidance's last ranks), beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; no other band changes. Sim-accuracy round 29 (walks-heal): Improved Renew 10 to 12 and Holy Specialization 13 to 17 before Twilight Focus, Divine Fury 18 and 19, Inspiration 20 to 22, Twilight Focus 23, 24 and 29, Holy Binding 25 (its Flash Heals heal the priest too), Improved Healing 26 to 28, Litany of Light, Spiritual Guidance to 4, Spirit of Redemption and Spiritual Healing by 39, so all thirty Holy points are in for Prayer of Mending at 40 with Divine Fury's last three points held back; from 41 Twin Disciplines, Mental Strength, Meditation by 53 (Discipline talents behind their own rows), Inner Focus, Mental Agility, and Divine Fury 58 to 60. +0.8 to +7.9% at 10 to 19, +0.1 to +0.7% at 20 to 24, +9.3 to +15.5% at 25 to 31, +1.1 to +8.0% at 32 to 59, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions.

priest-shadow.reason: Round 15's order (Wand Specialization 2, Spirit Tap 5, then the Shadow damage talents) stays. Then Shadow Weaving 31 to 33 before Blackout (a stun proc) and Vampiric Embrace (a global spent on healing, which loses damage the level it is taken), both tolls for Darkness at 37; Shadowform still at 42. In Discipline, Mental Strength, Mental Agility, Inner Focus and Meditation before Silent Resolve (threat), which takes the last point. Gains at every level 31 to 35 and 48 to 59 (sim-accuracy round 29, walks-dps lane; bare band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, design/reviews/2026-11-07-sim-audit-round29/walksdps.md).

rogue-assassination.reason: The rotation casts Mutilate (the 30-point row since client 1.60.1.70755, behind Venom, learned at 40). The plain walk never reaches Venom on the way down, so Venom and then Mutilate are taken as soon as each fits: Venom at 29, where it also makes every Shank raise your poisons, and Mutilate at 40. Before 70755 Mutilate sat on the 20-point row and was taken at 30 for about 8% at band 30 (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Malice 5 at 10 to 14, then Ruthlessness 3, Improved Slice and Dice 2 and Lethality 2, come ahead of Improved Gouge and Remorseless Attacks: the rotation never casts Gouge and Remorseless Attacks needs a kill, so neither does anything in a fight. +1.3% at level 10, +6.7% at 14, +3.0% at 20, +0.3% at 25, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions; the order rejoins the old one at 28 (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane; wowfdb.com and wowforevercompass.com Forever Assassination leveling orders open Malice 10 to 14).

rogue-combat.reason: Precision (+1% hit a point) at 15 to 17 and Puncturing Wounds (Backstab crit) at 18 to 20 come ahead of Lightning Reflexes past the one point the 5-point row toll needs, since its dodge does nothing while the target hits someone else; Lightning Reflexes finishes at 21 to 24, where the order rejoins the old one; Adrenaline Rush stays at 40, as the plain walk takes it. Bare, band 20 dagger, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level 15 level (Precision's first point is lost to the level-gap hit penalty), 16 +1.0%, 17 +2.1%, 18 +5.5%, 20 +5.5%, 22 +2.2%; with a sword Precision first gains 2.1% at 17 and 2.9% at 20 while Puncturing Wounds gains nothing, so Precision leads (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane).

rogue-subtlety.reason: The rotation casts Premeditation (the 10-point row since client 1.60.1.70755), Ghostly Strike (the 15-point row) and Hemorrhage (the 20-point row, behind Serrated Blades 3). They are reserved in tier order, Elusiveness's first rank ahead of Ghostly Strike because the engine does not model it (Vanish is never cast), so every level only adds points. On the 70753 trees the reservation gained about 2.6% at band 20 and 6.7% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Initiative (a combo point on every Garrote, cast after each Ghostly Strike) is held from 24, two points before Ghostly Strike and the third after it, in place of Camouflage and Elusiveness, which only pay the row tolls: +0.4% at level 25 and +1.0% at level 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 26, melee lane). Opportunity (+4% a point to Backstab, Garrote and Ambush) is held first, at 10 to 14, ahead of Master of Deception, which only helps sneak past mobs: level 10 ties with the band's mace and gains 1.4% with a dagger, level 14 +0.5% and level 15 +0.3%, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 27, orders lane).

shaman-elemental.reason: Elemental Alacrity 15 to 17 before Concussion; Elemental Warding and Trial by Fire (damage taken; Fire Nova and Magma Totem are two-target lines) only pay the 20-point row, so Call of Thunder comes at 30 and Lightning Overload 31 to 33 before Trial by Fire's second point; after Lightning Mastery, Tidal Focus (5% spell hit) before Thundering Strikes. shaman-enhancement.reason: Mental Dexterity (attack power from Intellect) 15 to 17 before Ancestral Knowledge; Stormstrike as soon as its row opens and Rage of the Farseer at 40 (round 15). Improved Ghost Wolf (travel) waits for 41: Mental Quickness 33 and 34 and Maelstrom Weapon 35 to 39, so the instant Lightning Bolt the rotation waits for at five points comes at 39 instead of 42. After one point of Convection, Tidal Focus (5% hit for your swings) at 44 to 48. Gains at every level that moves except 36 to 38 and 44, which tie (sim-accuracy round 29, walks-dps lane; bare band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, design/reviews/2026-11-07-sim-audit-round29/walksdps.md).

shaman-restoration.reason: On band 20's own fight, Mindfulness's second rank ahead of Tidal Focus's last rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions (round 11); Water Shield, which the rotation casts, taken as soon as it can be held (ahead of Tidal Focus's fourth rank) beats that beyond error at band 20 too, both factions (round 12); no other band changes. warlock-affliction.reason: Grim Reach (range), Soul Harvest (a Drain Soul kill) and Improved Drains (the rotation never channels a drain) wait: Amplify Curse 22, Pandemic 23 to 25 and Malevolence 26 and 27 (their rows are already paid), Grim Reach as Siphon Life's toll, Siphon Life 30 (round 13), Soul Siphon 31 to 33 as Shadow Mastery's toll and ready for Wrack, Shadow Mastery 35 to 39, Wrack 40. Gains at every level that moves, 22 to 59 (sim-accuracy round 29, walks-dps lane; bare band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, design/reviews/2026-11-07-sim-audit-round29/walksdps.md).

warlock-demonology.reason: The rotation casts Soul Link before the pull (the 20-point row, behind Demonic Sacrifice). A level 30 warlock's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Decimation's second rank, which does nothing before Soul Fire at 48. Taking Soul Link as soon as it fits gains about 2.3% at band 30, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Bare, band gear, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions: level 10 +0.14%, 15 +0.9 to +1.1%, 20 +0.4 to +0.7%, 23 +0.2%, 24 level (two dead points traded), 31 to 33 +3.1 to +3.3% (sim-accuracy round 28, casters lane).

warlock-destruction.reason: Destructive Reach (range) and Molten Skin (damage taken) do nothing in a fight, so they wait until a deeper row needs their points: Bane 10 to 14, Aftermath 15 to 17, Cataclysm 18 and 19, Shadowburn 20, Ruin 21 to 24, Agonizing Flames 25 to 27 and Ruin 28, then Destructive Reach 29. Conflagrate eats Immolate and loses damage until Fire and Brimstone backs it (-0.5% at 34 with no Fire and Brimstone), so Bane of Havoc, the Incinerate toll, comes at 30, Conflagrate at 31, Fire and Brimstone 32 to 34 and Shadow and Flame 35 to 38, five levels sooner; Destructive Reach 39, Incinerate 40, Molten Skin 41 to 43, and level 44 is the guide build. A level 40 warrior's 31 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the last one on Weaponmaster. Taking Mortal Strike as soon as it fits gains about 20% at band 40, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 13, walk lane). Improved Overpower is held first, from 15: Overpower is cast from 12, while the walk's Improved Tactical Mastery only keeps rage through a stance change, which the rotation makes only for Recklessness from 50; +3.3% at level 20, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions (sim-accuracy round 26, melee lane). warrior-fury.reason: Berserker Rage joins the rotation only at 36, so Improved Berserker Rage's first point at 34 is Flurry's row toll and its second waits for 41: Flurry 35 to 37, Improved Whirlwind 38 and 39 (Whirlwind trains at 36), Bloodthirst 40 (Death Wish still at 30). warrior-protection.reason: Sim-accuracy 2026-11-12 (Protection warrior lane): Shield Specialization first at 10 to 14, Improved Revenge 15 to 17 and Improved Bloodrage 18 and 19, so Defiance still opens at 20. Once Bloodrage pays its fifth of base health and rage from damage taken ignores armor, the block rage beats the Bloodrage rage at every level 10 to 18: threat +14.8% at 11, +10.1% at 13 (+9.0% Horde), +5.1% at 14, +5.9% at 15, +7.2% at 16, +7.0% at 17, +3.1% at 18, every cell beyond the error on seeds 1 and 50001, chance of death 0 either way, 19 on identical (bare band 20 gear on the 48 s pull, 10,000 iterations, design/reviews/2026-11-12-sim-accuracy/protection-warrior.md).
